titulo_ja: かえって と むしろ

bloques.titulo: The result was contrary to what was expected; the result is that it chooses an option as most appropriate.
texto: They are not interchangeable in all contexts.
(Although I had an early bed, I ended up wearier.)
The train is more practical than the car.

frases.ja: はやく ねた のに、 かえって つかれて しまいました。
frases.es: Aunque me acosté temprano, acabé más cansado.
frases.en: Even though I was early in bed, I got weary.

frases.ja: くるま より、 むしろ でんしゃ の ほう が べんり です。
frases.es: Más que el coche, resulta más práctico el tren.
frases.en: More than the car, the train is more practical.
